name: smwmusic-spider-man
title: Spider-Man 2 - Pizza Theme
description:
🍕 Pizza Time 🍕

Just like in the original, this particular version of the neapolitan song "Funiculì Funiculà" gets slightly dissonant, higher in pitch and faster, as time passes, and it never loops back once it ends.
The only use of this would be in a time limited level, which would also reset the song when you re-enter the level.
